system_placeholders.{{timeOfDay}}: type: string | Example: morning, afternoon, evening

user_context.{{userConstraints}}: Work hours, family obligations, etc. | Source: aboutme.md
user_context.{{userKnownPatterns}}: Behavioral patterns, habits, blockers | Source: memory.md

current_state.{{todayTaskList}}: Planned tasks for today | Source: daily/2026/04/{{todayDate}}.md or null
current_state.{{thisWeekGoals}}: Goals for current week | Source: goals/index.json
current_state.{{thisWeekProgress}}: Percentage progress on this week's goals | Source: computed from daily files
current_state.{{last7DaysSummary}}: Summary of last 7 days activity | Source: daily/index.json
current_state.{{currentStreak}}: Days in a row with alignment ≥ 50% | Source: system/score.json
current_state.{{currentStatus}}: IN GAME or OUT OF GAME | Source: system/score.json

pattern_detection.{{neglectedAreas}}: List of areas not touched in 5+ days | Source: patterns/neglected-areas.json
pattern_detection.{{recurringMistakes}}: Same mistakes repeated 3+ times | Source: patterns/recurring-mistakes.md
pattern_detection.{{daysSinceLastActivity}}: Days since last activity per area | Source: computed

skip_day_logic.{{daysSinceLastEntry}}: Number of days without daily file | Source: computed (0 = today, 1+ = gap)
skip_day_logic.{{lastEntryDate}}: Date of most recent daily file | Source: computed
skip_day_logic.{{skipDayFlag}}: Boolean: true if daysSinceLastEntry > 1 | Source: computed
skip_day_logic.{{inProgressTasks}}: Tasks that were in progress when user left | Source: system/checkpoints.json
